notes: Web 460 — LAYOUT-RESTORE-DISPATCH (Nov 15, 2026; layers on web 459). The owner's order, verbatim: "Why did you mess with the layout? I only asked you to repair the ocr not the layout!" — the 457/459 intake work never moved a card; it GREW the suggestion card until it filled the whole first screen and pushed every section out of sight. This build restores the Dispatch screen's section order and names it as his law, and finishes the OCR repair he originally asked for. NOTHING else about the layout changes — no card added, removed or restyled. (1) SECTION ORDER (refined by him the same evening: "Active comes out second if upcoming is there... If not 1st then read from text"): Upcoming first when one stands; Active second when Upcoming stands and FIRST when none does; then Read from a message (the paste box + Read message, with the Camera and Choose-from-file doors directly under it — the v457 doors, kept); then the form door / form; History under all of it. Sections that do not exist that day do not appear — no empty placeholders. The Active card is now BUILT at the top of the render and SPLICED into its ordered place (directly under Upcoming, or at the top when no future-dated dispatch stands); its markup and wiring are byte-identical. Pinned on the real rendered screen by tools/dispatch-layout-460-test.js. (2) PU-DEL-ADDRESS-FIELDS (his words: "Where are pu and delivery addresses?"): the suggestion card now stands a Pickup address row and a Delivery address row on EVERY document-shaped suggestion — filled by the reader when it can, empty and editable when it cannot — and the Consignee name row stands with them (before, a read that found no addresses showed NO address fields at all). The reader also learned the block-headed party name ("Shipper:" alone, the name on the next printed line — the trip-report table shape), and a named party now counts as place structure in the intake score, so a trip report whose party addresses did not survive the camera read still becomes a suggestion instead of vanishing. Card edits to the always-standing rows save through the same updateSuggestionFields door and carry into the saved dispatch like every confirmed field. (3) DRIVER-FIELDS-EDITABLE (his words: "why are the drivers not editable?"): Driver 1 and Driver 2 are detail fields now — read from the document ("Driver 1:RaeesKhan", "Driver 2:AdeelKhan" in the trip report's header; a name runs to the next printed label and a digit-bearing value is refused), rendered as editable inputs on the card through the same detail machinery, and carried into the saved dispatch (notes lines + the structured details) on Use, like every other confirmed field. They are fixed-form and not learned. The details patch cap rose 12 -> 14 so a full card (11 + 2 drivers) can never lose its last field to an edit. (4) THE OCR REPAIR, finished: his screenshot's PRO pair — "PRO00299219" + "PRO0299219" — is the same printed number read twice with one zero dropped by the camera; the v459 de-duplication compared values as printed, so it slipped past. The same-type containment now also compares the digit runs with leading zeros stripped (equal runs, or one a suffix of the other, are the same number; the fuller printed read is kept). Two genuinely different PRO numbers still land as two fields — pinned in the new suite against the pristine-459 reader, which yields two. HONEST LIMITS: the trip report's printed street/city party addresses still cannot be machine-proven — no real trip-report OCR text exists on file (the 459 fixture's party blocks were constructed, and his two screenshots show the card, not the document) — so on his document the address rows may still stand empty for his typing; the fill is proven only on the constructed-layout fixture. His verdict on the real photo is the proof. Bench: new suite tools/dispatch-layout-460-test.js 33/0 (real-module render: section order in all three day shapes; card fields; drivers read/edit/carry; PRO pair vs two real PROs). dispatch-intake-459 89/0 (its count pins updated for the two driver details the R6 header now yields), dispatch-ingest 217/0, dispatch-photo-intake-v457 88/0, dashboard-tile-rearrange 55/0 unregressed. NO NATIVE CHANGE.
